100:t_006:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We came out into space with no preparation at all, and at this rate...!」

100:t_008:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is $$ソレスタルビーイング$$. We will provide support from here.」

100:t_008:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Perfect timing! That's a big help!」

100:t_008:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「What a touching reunion. Let's add some flair with a victory.」

100:t_008:3.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「These two months... it seems they've been struggling over here too.」

100:t_008:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has started to move, we don't have much time left.」

100:t_008:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, support the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ while intercepting $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

100:t_010:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$キュベレイ$$...! Is that $$ハマーン・カーン$$!?」

100:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ハマーン$$... I never thought you'd come out to the front lines...」

100:t_010:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The situation demands that I do.」

100:t_010:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$... The one $$シャア・アズナブル$$ entrusted $$ネオ・ジオン$$ to...」

100:t_010:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ is here too... How convenient.」

100:t_010:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't misunderstand. I want to talk with you.」

100:t_010:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Be silent, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

100:t_010:13.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, its pilot, and $$ソレスタルビーイング$$... Come to me.」

100:t_010:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...What are you getting at with that?」

100:t_010:16.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I cannot discuss it now. That comes only after you have first come to me.」

100:t_010:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$. Don't think you can move people with methods like that.」

100:t_010:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This is no business of yours, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

100:t_010:19.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now... let me hear your answer.」

100:t_010:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「Wait... You can't just say something like that out of nowhere...」

100:t_010:22.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I wasn't asking the captain. ...Answer, $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

100:t_010:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we refuse, they'll come at us by force anyway! Don't hold back!」

100:t_010:28.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! You...!!」

100:t_010:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This $$ユニコーン$$ was entrusted to me! Unless I'm convinced, I have no intention of handing it over to anyone!」

100:t_010:30.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ gives the same answer, $$ハマーン$$. If you're proposing we fight together, we'd like to see something enough to earn our trust.」

100:t_010:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ハマーン$$! For us to fight now...」

100:t_010:33.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That is exactly why I will take it by force...!」

100:t_010:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$! $$ロックオン$$, $$アレルヤ$$, $$ティエリア$$!」

100:t_010:35.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know! Our target is $$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

100:t_010:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, target $$ハマーン$$! We'll stop her and find out what $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is after!」

100:t_011:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「As expected, they won't go down easily.」

100:t_011:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This will call for a suitable plan.」

100:t_011:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're too familiar, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

100:t_011:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Answer me! Do you know where the Colonel is!?」

100:t_011:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And if I do, what of it?」

100:t_011:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If it's the Colonel, he'll surely play the role of connecting Earth and space!」

100:t_011:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So you, too, overestimate that man.」

100:t_011:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$ハマーン$$! I want to talk!」

100:t_011:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm your enemy! Don't get cozy with me!」

100:t_012:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
(Damn that $$ハマーン・カーン$$... What is she up to...?)

100:t_013:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All $$ネオ・ジオン$$ units have withdrawn.」

100:t_013:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Now we can catch our breath...」

100:t_013:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「But why did $$ハマーン・カーン$$ ask to make contact with us, I wonder...」

100:t_013:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I hear she's one of those $$ニュータイプ$$ too. Maybe she took an interest in $$刹那$$?」

100:t_013:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$... Do you have any idea?」

100:t_013:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$スメラギ$$... Since you came here, does that mean you'll lend us a hand?」

100:t_013:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes. If we keep fighting these local battles, we'll only end up on the back foot.」

100:t_013:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To break through this situation, I propose we concentrate our forces, even at the cost of casualties.」

100:t_013:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. First, let's rendezvous and exchange information.」

100:t_013:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$ラプラスの箱$$... $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is still chasing it...)

100:t_013:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Even in a situation like this, the war between Earth and space still goes on...?)

100:t_013:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... Where are you now...?)

100:t_014:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch...! Even the $$ギラ・ズール$$ is at its limit!」

100:t_014:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Remember this, $c...! Our true fight begins today!」

100:t_015:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(If that man has come, then... is $$フル・フロンタル$$ really alive too, after all...?)

100:t_100:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you after, going for the $$ユニコーン$$!? What meaning does it have on today's Earth!?」

100:t_100:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$! If I take you down, $$ギュネイ$$ will be frustrated!」
